artifact_name: v1.9 Organic-Style Controlled Discovery / External-Fork Replay Pilot Plan

episode_003_result_preserved.interpretation: Episode 003 remains negative evidence for memory lift on a simple local seeded hash-mismatch task.

acceptance_criteria: repo is user-owned, forked, or locally cloned ethically
license permits local testing/forking, or Brad owns it
failure can be reproduced from clean checkout
failure is discovered or semi-organic where possible
no-memory and memory-enabled paths can run under identical replay conditions
all logs and artifacts can be captured and hashed
rejection_criteria: failure depends only on expired CI logs
setup requires private services or secrets

preferred_mix: at least one user-owned discovered failure if feasible
at least one forked public repo replay if feasible
user-owned discovered or semi-organic failures first if public repo discovery is too costly
candidate_search_order: user-owned repos with locally reproducible discovered failures
authorized user-owned repos with semi-organic validator discoveries
forked public repos with replayable issue/CI/build/test failures
archived public repos with deterministic dependency drift
synthetic seeded fallback only if no discovered failure can be obtained safely

organic_style_memory_lift_demonstrated_o: at least 3 v1.9 episodes become deterministic replay-ready limited scoring episodes
memory-enabled outperforms no-memory in at least 2 episodes
no positive memory episode has corruption
replay/custody passes for all positive episodes
aggregate_v1_9_rule.blocked_candidate_acquisition_interpreta: blocked_candidate_acquisition_failure is not negative capability evidence

stop_conditions: candidate acquisition consumes too much resource without replayable tasks

evidence_type_distinctions.seeded_controlled_evidence: Designed deterministic tasks useful for mechanism testing but not organic repo proof.
evidence_type_distinctions.user_owned_discovered_or_semi_organic_ev: Authorized repo evidence with stronger realism than seeded tasks but still owner-controlled.
evidence_type_distinctions.forked_public_repo_evidence: Public repo replay evidence that must preserve license/custody and be labeled separately.
evidence_type_distinctions.organic_style_evidence: Discovered or semi-organic deterministic replay evidence; still limited until broader external validation exists.
